prices.source: router.huggingface.co/v1/models (Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B provider cerebras: $0.99 input, $1.49 output per million tokens)

data_retention_note: Hugging Face forwards each request to the pinned third-party provider (Cerebras), whose own data-retention policy applies. Lab camera images and depth data sent with every call leave this machine.
model_verified: 2026-10-02: router.huggingface.co/v1/models lists Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (Apache-2.0) with image+text input on novita, cerebras, ovhcloud, deepinfra and featherless; cerebras has supports_structured_output true, ~831 tok/s and a 65,536-token context. The model card documents thinking on by default, reasoning_effort xhigh (default) / medium / low, thinking sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95, and reasoning returned as reasoning / reasoning_content. Vision and reasoning both verified.
notes: MLLM-01 per 15-CONTEXT.md D-13/D-15/D-20/D-21/D-23. Pinned to cerebras (structured output, fastest at ~831 tok/s) because unpinned :fastest routing can land on a provider without structured output (novita has none; research C2, Pitfall 2). Cerebras' 65,536-token context must hold the ~15K-token prompt plus the reasoning budget, so max_tokens is 32000 with a 16000-token prompt reserve (Pitfall 10). If that context turns out to be limiting, deepinfra ($0.20 / $2.50 per million tokens, 262K context, structured output) is the alternative pin. effort xhigh is the model's highest level (research C11). The shared sampling 1.0 / 0.95 is sent as-is; whether the provider honours it is confirmed live. Cost is cents per call (research C1); no model on the router is free. No replacement from the D-23 shortlist (google/gemma-4-31B-it, zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) was needed: all three HF models passed the vision and reasoning checks. The first live smoke per variant (Plan 15-10) must confirm routing to the pinned provider, reasoning tokens and reasoning text under json_schema mode (assumptions A3/A4) and image acceptance (A6; set image_format to jpeg if the provider rejects the request size). If the pinned provider rejects json_schema, a human sets structured_mode to json_object (schema in the system prompt, client-side validation); there is no automatic fallback. api_key_env names the environment variable holding a fine-grained HF token with Inference Providers permission; never put the token itself in this file.
